Dear Rosa,

The rain finally let up yesterday, so I got out to the garden before the weeds took over. The tomatoes are doing better than last year, though the squirrels found the ripest ones before I did. You would laugh at the scarecrow I rigged from an old broom and one of Dad's shirts. The neighbors' cat has adopted us, and he follows me around like a small dog. Come visit whenever you can; the spare room is ready.
